title: "02_expression_clean"
format: html
---

##Load libraries, read the data and drop NAs and Duplicates
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(hugene10sttranscriptcluster.db)

# 1. Load and clean expression matrix
expr <- read_csv("../data/GSE114489_expression.csv")
colnames(expr)[1] <- "probeID"

#2. Drop NAs and duplicates
initial <- dim(expr)

expr <- expr |> 
  mutate(probeID = as.character(probeID)) |> 
  distinct(probeID, .keep_all = TRUE) |> 
  drop_na()

final <- dim(expr)
```
As we can see no NAs or duplicates existed in the data frame

##Map probeIDs to ENTREZ IDs

We need to map each of the probe IDs to ENSEMBL IDs. to do that we first create a tibble with the ensembl IDs and then we join that tibble with the expr data frame. The microarray used Affymetrix Human Gene 1.0 ST Array (HuGene-1_0-st), so we look up into the corresponding annotation package

```{r}
# 2. Query chip's annotation package
probe_map <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  hugene10sttranscriptcluster.db,  
  keys = as.character(expr$probeID),         
  columns = "ENTREZID",
  keytype = "PROBEID"              
) |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  dplyr::rename(probeID = PROBEID, ENTREZ_ID = ENTREZID) |>  #dplyr::because it would use base::rename instead
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(ENTREZ_ID)) |> 
  dplyr::distinct(probeID, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

##Join ENTREZ IDs data frame to expr data frame
```{r}
# 3. Join Entrez IDs to expression data and average duplicate genes
expr_clean <- expr |> 
  dplyr::inner_join(probe_map, by = "probeID") |>   #without dplyr:: its doesnt work even if tidyverse is loaded
  dplyr::select(-probeID) 

dim(expr_clean)
glimpse(expr_clean[, 1:6])
```

##Save the expr_entrez to an .rds file to match metadata file format
```{r}
write_rds(expr_clean, "../data/GSE114489_cleaned_entrez.rds")
```
